concept: Stateless web tier: offload sessions to ElastiCache/DynamoDB
tests: Where to store sessions so they survive instance termination during scale-in.
expected: External session store — ElastiCache for Redis or DynamoDB; the web tier stays stateless. Triggers: "session data must survive instance termination", "scale-in".
why_not: In-memory, instance store and a specific instance's EBS are lost (or unavailable) when it is terminated.
